_comment: Pinned ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes for the two countries this catalog covers (US, CA) — build plan §4.1 Region.code. Gate review round 2 nit: RegionCodeSchema previously validated the SHAPE only (a regex, ^(US|CA)-[A-Z]{2,3}$), which let a non-existent code like 'US-ZZ' through. This is the full, stable ISO 3166-2:US and ISO 3166-2:CA list (50 states + DC + the 5 inhabited US territories with their own ISO 3166-2 entry; 10 Canadian provinces + 3 territories) as of ISO 3166-2 edition 2020 (updates to this list are rare — territory/province boundaries do not change).
